BiblicalUsage: A palace is the word for a great house, and all three uses are in Esther, around the king's feast and Haman's fall. In Esther 1:5 the king made a feast in the court of the garden of the king's palace. In Esther 7:7 the king arose in his wrath from the banquet and went into the palace garden, and in Esther 7:8 he returned from the palace garden to the place of the banquet, and found Haman fallen on the bed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the palace garden in Esther is where the story turns: the king walks out in wrath, and walks back in to find Haman fallen.
